description: The `casegraphen://spaces/{id}/halts`, `casegraphen://runs/{run_id}`, and `casegraphen://topologies/{topology_id}` `resources/read` shape (ResourceProjection, src/bin/casegraphen-mcp-host.rs::read_external_projection), the only three of the seven RESOURCE_TEMPLATES that carry a top-level claim: this wraps content an external runtime wrote to the artifact directory, and `accepted` is pinned const:false and required (#117's pattern; either alone is evadable) because only the canonical review morphism accepts anything. The other four resource templates (status, frontier, reviews, revisions/{revision}) are pure ledger echoes with no claim key at their own top level and are deliberately left uncontracted here (ADR 0036) — this schema governs this one shape only, not resources/read as a whole. `projection` is left open: it is the runtime-authored content this record wraps, not this record's own claim.
